name: cc-dazzle
description: Draws Claude Code's transcript in Catppuccin Mocha: boxed code blocks, box tables, Mermaid diagrams, diff cards in Claude's colors, compact tool rows and timed prompts. Optional stretchtext replies.

stretch.title: Stretchtext replies
stretch.description: Claude writes short replies whose phrases grow in place when you click them, and « shrinks them back. Clicks need the fullscreen terminal or the desktop app.

copyButtonStyle.title: Copy buttons
copyButtonStyle.description: inline: copy buttons always show beside their block. hover: they show only while the pointer is over the block, and take no space. The phone app always shows them inline.
